race.title: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
race.verdict: THE MONKEY POLE promises to do better as a chaser judged on last week's effort at Thurles but there are still races to be won with him over hurdles from this mark. Frontier Rose is pretty solid at this level, while Dunmore requires a market check in receipt of his 3-y-o allowance now handicapping. THE MONKEY POLE (IRE) FRONTIER ROSE DUNMORE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: The Monkey Pole (2/1), Frontier Rose (4/1), Makaiah (6/1), Dunmore (8/1), Get It Right (10/1), Theanniversary Man (10/1), Maciver (12/1), Devine Genius (12/1), Boston Bongo (16/1), Nothing Da Now (25/1)
